name: Uruwashi no Kimi ~Anata no Naka ni Sasagu~
original_name: 麗しの君～貴女の膣内に捧ぐ～
source:
"I wanna date her...." Takuma is in love with Shiori. One day, Elena, a dropout succubus, suddenly appears in front of him and says, "I'll give you a hand." It seems if she fails this time, she will be expelled from her world. Takuma knows it is not fair, but he asks her to help him. Like this, he starts dating Shiori, who is beautiful, smart, and good at sports, and enjoys his school life. Any dream, however, ends sometime soon. What will happen to Takuma, Shiori, and Elena...? 

[description by Honoohhh from Hongfire forums]
translation:
「我想和她交往……」藤代琢磨爱慕水无濑诗织。一天，退学的魅魔艾琳娜突然出现在他面前，说道：「我来帮你。」看来这次失败的话，她就会被逐出自己的世界。琢磨知道这并不公平，却请求她帮忙。于是，他开始与美丽、聪明又擅长运动的诗织交往，享受校园生活。但任何美梦终会结束。琢磨、诗织和艾琳娜将迎来什么结局……？

[简介由Hongfire论坛的Honoohhh撰写]
